prompt_for_image_ai:
Create ONE flat vector landing sticker.

SIZE LOCK — CRITICAL FOR LETTER A (A is often wrongly generated too wide AND too short):
- Canvas: exactly 1024px wide × 1024px tall. Fill entire canvas with solid paper #FDFCF8. No transparency. No black background.
- Sticker frame: exactly 780px OUTER WIDTH × 640px OUTER HEIGHT — THE SAME WIDTH AND THE SAME HEIGHT as letters R, S, and C.
- Do NOT make A wider than R. Do NOT make A shorter than R. Do NOT make a landscape banner. Do NOT make a short wide card.
- Aspect ratio of the frame is fixed at 780:640.
- Corner radius ~48px. Border stroke ~10px lavender #B39DDB ONLY — frame border is NOT yellow and NOT orange.
- Frame centered: left margin 122px, right margin 122px, top margin 192px, bottom margin 192px.
- Interior fill #FDFCF8.

HEIGHT LOCK: the frame outer height is 640px — identical to R/S/C. Character head sits near the top inner border (~24px padding). Character waist and props are flush to and cropped by the INNER bottom border. Character fills the full interior height — no floating, no short figure with empty paper above and below.

LARGE LETTER LOCK (match gold R, S, C): left half, bold rounded SANS-SERIF block capital A. Fill #FFD54F yellow. Thin white inner offset stroke. Thick dark outer outline #2D2D2D. Letter height about 420px, vertically centered — same letter height as R/S/C. Only the letter is yellow; the frame stays lavender. NOT serif, NOT a different blockier style than R/S/C.

CORNER BADGE: ~56px circle bottom-right inside frame, small capital A, yellow fill on lavender ring, same sans style.

CHARACTER: young Creator, warm tan skin, wavy auburn-brown hair, lavender headband, thin 2px outline #2D2D2D, flat fills, minimal black dot eyes. Faces inward-left toward A. White tee, open yellow overshirt #FFD54F. Right hand: paintbrush at chest/shoulder. Left forearm: flat palette across torso. Waist flush to bottom border.

Style: KursoKo questionnaire unDraw flat vector. Minimal props. No beret, no easel, no music notes.
